title: MFL draft reports
mflLabel: Open MFL draft results (picks happen on MFL)

reports.title: Draft results · pick by pick
reports.how: Picks sorted by numeric round, then pick within round, not by franchise or response order. Owners are the franchises recorded for each pick; MFL comments retain its trade chain without inferring an original owner. MFL timestamp strings are Unix seconds (UTC instants), displayed in this computer's local time zone. MFL player 0000 means a skipped pick, not a player or an unmade slot. These are held exports, not a real-time clock; refresh failures retain the last good copy.

reports.title: Steals and busts · distance from expected
reports.note: Value: fixture model run, as of 2026-10-11
reports.source: Source: MFL draftResults + held app model (DynastyPPG)
reports.how: Picks sorted by numeric round, then pick within round, not by franchise or response order. Owners are the franchises recorded for each pick; MFL comments retain its trade chain without inferring an original owner. MFL timestamp strings are Unix seconds (UTC instants), displayed in this computer's local time zone. MFL player 0000 means a skipped pick, not a player or an unmade slot. These are held exports, not a real-time clock; refresh failures retain the last good copy. Value is the app's latest held DynastyPPG: discounted expected league points per game across its configured dynasty horizon. Expected is the median held value of drafted players in the same round, not an ADP or draft-day valuation. A bar is the point distance from that baseline (no uncertainty estimate and no letter grade); missing values are not zero. This retrospective comparison is not proof a draft pick was good or bad.

reports.title: Average elapsed time per pick
reports.how: Picks sorted by numeric round, then pick within round, not by franchise or response order. Owners are the franchises recorded for each pick; MFL comments retain its trade chain without inferring an original owner. MFL timestamp strings are Unix seconds (UTC instants), displayed in this computer's local time zone. MFL player 0000 means a skipped pick, not a player or an unmade slot. These are held exports, not a real-time clock; refresh failures retain the last good copy. Average wall-clock seconds from the preceding pick in draft order to this franchise's pick, including overnight pauses and zero-second pre-draft picks. First pick, missing timestamps and negative intervals are excluded; no active timer or pause subtraction is available.
